Need a separate pass for transformer-specific public names and OTC/foreign-listed candidates such as Hammond Power Solutions or Hitachi Energy peers, because this pass was limited to US-listed candidates and obvious direct exposure.

node: Grid transformers, high-voltage equipment, switchgear, and conductors
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the grid equipment chokepoint using a two-lane funnel. Reference lane: Hubbell as a larger, obvious utility T&D component leader. Underfollowed/discovery lane: Powell Industries for medium-voltage switchgear and backlog sensitivity, Preformed Line Products for conductor/pole-line hardware, and Atkore for electrical infrastructure products tied to data-center, solar, industrial, and electrification demand. These are research candidates only, not recommendations.
